safetyAssertions: Use video_time_s for alignment; timestamp has no timezone and is not needed.
Exclude filtered-or-derived reference points from primary metrics.
Exclude manual corrections and low-confidence OCR from primary algorithm metrics.

Keep every single-character HR candidate in manual-review status even when frames agree.
Reject multiple candidates, decimals, negative values, and values above 200 without clamping or guessing.
Report agreement with the supplied reference source, not clinical accuracy.
